parts.name: Shield shell Ø609.6 × 12.7 × 1285, rear Ø590.6 × 12 counterbore
Ring 1, 110 thk A572 Gr 42, Ø384 × 30 counterbore
Ring 1 weld, 14 mm fillet from the front
Pipe welds: 6 × 45° front seal weld + 6 mm rear fillet
Seal-purge line Ø8 in OD groove
M30 eye bolt in spindle nose (fixture)
Head welds (12 mm gusset-to-arm, 8 mm hub)
Seal-purge supply line, part 2 (to R185 and the surface)
ROTEX 160 hub, spindle side (steel, Ø180 bore)
Hydraulic motor, Poclain MS18 2,812 cc (body approximate)
Motor pilot plate Ø400 × 20 (Ø300 spigot, Ø282 recess)
Hoses A, B (3/4 in) + case drain
Thrust ring 76.2 thk A572-50, Ø609.6 × Ø400, Ø589.5 × 10 register, notched 12 + 6 (Rev B)
Saddle welds, 8 mm fillet (none past the ring OD)

steps.title: Shell on riser blocks
steps.text: Shield shell Ø609.6 × 12.7 × 1,285. Both ends faced on the lathe first; the front end face is the depth datum. Stands on its rear end on three 110 mm riser blocks on a flat table (the slurry pipes will stand 98 mm proud of the rear end).

steps.title: Gauge legs
steps.text: Three legs, 1,157 long (tube with ground ends), stand on the table inside the shell at R255, 120° apart. Their tops set ring 1's seat 128.0 from the front end.

steps.title: Ring 1 + slurry pipes (bench sub-weldment) onto the legs
steps.text: Ring 1 is finished before welding: waterjet blank from 4.5 in A572 Gr 42, Blanchard-ground to 110, lathe for the Ø384 × 30 counterbore and Ø318.5 bore, 16 × M12 tapped. On the bench, the Ø76.2 × 6.35 slurry pipes (1,255 long) are pushed through ring 1 at 12 and 6, welded at the front face (6 × 45° bevel) and at the rear face (6 mm fillet); seat flatness re-checked (≤ 0.05). The sub-weldment is lowered onto the legs, pipes down; 3 shims in the 0.5 mm OD gap centre it.

steps.title: Weld ring 1
steps.text: Depth 128.0 ± 0.5 at 4 points. Tack 8 places, then the 14 mm fillet from the front in 4 opposed quadrants. Preheat 66 °C, interpass ≤ 250 °C. At 12 and 6 the ring fillet runs into the pipe seal weld (8.6 mm apart). After cooling: seat flatness ≤ 0.05, depth re-checked.

steps.title: Legs out
steps.text: Shell lifted off the blocks; legs removed through the rear end between the pipes; shell set back on the blocks.

steps.title: Pipe saddles
steps.text: Saddles welded in under the pipes from the open rear end (x = 950, 207 mm in from the rear).

steps.title: Pressure taps
steps.text: Two Ø12 tap tubes at 3 and 9 o'clock, welded flush with the plate.

steps.title: Anti-roll fins
steps.text: Four fins, 20 × 70 × 990 plate, at 1, 3, 9 and 11 o'clock (clear of the launch rails at 5 and 7 and the lubrication ports at 10, 12 and 2). 30° lead ramp with a knife edge, 45° tail ramp, 2 × 8 mm fillets.

steps.title: Lifting bosses
steps.text: Four Ø60 × 40 bosses set flush into Ø60 holes at 12 o'clock ± 18°, x = 155 and 699 (either side of the machine CG at x = 424), full-penetration bevel groove weld from outside with the boss as backing. M20 × 32 tapped for Crosby HR-125M hoist rings (WLL 2,150 kg each); plugged with M20 set screws while tunnelling. Each boss is stencilled 'LIFT 700 kg'.

steps.title: Spider plate
steps.text: One waterjet piece from 2 in A572-50: 8 arms, centre, tab slots, cap pocket (milled 30 deep). Face down on the welding table.

steps.title: Hub ring
steps.text: Locking-assembly hub ring Ø340 × Ø190 × 50.8 (A572-50; Ø320 minimum for 165 MPa hub pressure), centred on a fixture pin through the spider centre. It goes on before the gussets: the gussets' inner edges step in to R125 above it, so it cannot be dropped in afterwards.

steps.title: Gussets into the slots
steps.text: Eight 25 mm gussets. Two tabs on each drop through the spider's slots, which sets position and squareness without a jig; the inner edges bear on the hub ring.

steps.title: Journal sleeve
steps.text: Journal sleeve drops into the R125 opening between the gusset edges and stands on the hub ring. Head thrust passes from the hub ring into the sleeve by contact, not through the weld.

steps.title: Weld and machine the head
steps.text: Gusset-to-spider 2 × 12 mm fillets, gusset-to-hub and gusset-to-sleeve 8 mm, tab plug welds. Then one lathe setup: Ø190 bore for the locking assembly, Ø140 bore, Ø170 seal journal, rear face, labyrinth rings.

steps.title: Turn the head over
steps.text: Head turned face-up.

steps.title: Bit holders and carbide
steps.text: 17 holders welded to the arms; trapezoid carbide bits brazed in. 3 bits share the gauge track at R308.65.

steps.title: Centre cap
steps.text: Centre cap, 30 mm plate, cut to clear the arm-0 and arm-3 holders. Carries the 7 inner bits (R ≤ 118) and the centre cone with 3 carbide blades.

steps.title: Spindle on its nose
steps.text: Spindle (Ø140, 4140 QT) stands on its nose on a stand.

steps.title: Backing ring
steps.text: Backing ring Ø190 dropped over the rear end onto the collar (supports the 29328 shaft washer out to Ø190; SKF da min 185).

steps.title: 29328N shaft washer + rollers
steps.text: Shaft washer with its roller set heated to 110 °C on the induction heater, dropped onto the backing ring, held down until cool.

steps.title: Turn the spindle over
steps.text: Spindle turned nose-up; it now stands on its drive end.

steps.title: Front 23228
steps.text: Front 23228 heated to 110 °C and dropped over the nose onto the collar.

steps.title: Cartridge tube
steps.text: Cartridge tube (seamless 323.9 × 60, turned to Ø318, no welds) front end up on a stand.

steps.title: Housing washer
steps.text: 29328N housing washer dropped in from the front onto the shoulder 233 mm down (Ø204 left as rolled; SKF Da max 208).

steps.title: Eye bolt
steps.text: M30 eye bolt into the spindle nose. The same thread later pulls the head on and pushes it off.

steps.title: Spindle into the tube
steps.text: Spindle lowered rear end first into the tube. The rollers seat on the housing washer; the front 23228 outer ring slides into its Ø250 seat.

steps.title: Turn the module over
steps.text: Eye bolt out. Module turned front-down and stood on the nose; the weight goes tube → housing washer → rollers → collar → nose.

steps.title: Spacer sleeve
steps.text: Spacer sleeve slid over the rear end down to the shaft washer.

steps.title: Rear 23228
steps.text: Rear 23228 heated to 110 °C, slid onto the shaft and into the rear seat together, pushing on the inner ring. This bearing floats axially in its seat.

steps.title: MB28 + KM28
steps.text: Lock washer, then the KM28 nut tightened with a hook spanner; one washer tab bent into a nut slot.

steps.title: Turn front-up
steps.text: Module turned front-up again.

steps.title: Seal carrier
steps.text: Carrier with 3 lip seals 170 × 200 × 15 and 2 lantern rings slid over the nose on an assembly cone. Push and pull the shaft with a dial indicator on the nose; shim to 0.10–0.20 end play. 12 × M6 countersunk, flush.

steps.title: O-ring and seal-purge line
steps.text: Static O-ring rolled over the tube end into its groove (seals the ring 1 bore). The seal-purge line (Ø8) lies in a 14 × 9 groove milled along the tube OD from the port at x = 125 to x = 600, so nothing stands above Ø318 when the module passes through ring 1. Bearings are packed with grease here; no relube lines (12 rpm, ≈ 1,200 head revolutions per 5 m).

steps.title: Split flange
steps.text: Flange halves into the groove from both sides.

steps.title: Split screws and pins
steps.text: 2 × M8 across each split at x = 22.5, R157 (clear of the flange bolt holes). First build: ream 4 radial Ø12 holes through the flange into the tube land and drive the pins in from outside.

steps.title: Module into ring 1
steps.text: Eye bolt back in. Module (≈ 330 kg) lifted and lowered rear end first through ring 1's Ø318.5 bore until the split flange sits in the counterbore. Flange flush with the plate face.

steps.title: Bolt and dowel
steps.text: 16 × M12 × 40 10.9 into ring 1 at 70 % proof (100 Nm). First assembly: ream 2 × Ø16 dowels through the flange into ring 1 at 12 and 6. Eye bolt out.

steps.title: Head onto the nose
steps.text: Head lowered onto the nose. The Ø170 journal passes the lip seals on a thin assembly sleeve and stops on the front 23228 inner ring.

steps.title: Locking assembly
steps.text: Locking assembly (140 × 190 × 50) slid into the gap between shaft and hub ring. Screws tightened in rounds to 123 Nm (B-LOC B400 catalogue).

steps.title: Centre cap
steps.text: Cap with the inner bits into its pocket; 8 × M8 countersunk. Two M12 holes in the cap pull it out later.

steps.title: Cap screws
steps.text: 8 × M8 countersunk.

steps.title: Turn the machine rear-up
steps.text: Riser blocks out. Machine turned rear end up and stood on a ring under the head.

steps.title: Seal-purge supply, part 1
steps.text: Supply line connected to the end of the groove line at x = 600 (560 mm down from the open rear end) and run back at R209 to x = 1,095; the loose end is tied out of the way.

steps.title: Adapter dowels
steps.text: 3 × Ø16 dowels pressed into the cartridge rear face (holes reamed with the adapter on the bench, first build).

steps.title: Drive adapter
steps.text: Adapter weldment (flanges + 14 in XS pipe, machined after welding) lowered over the shaft end onto the dowels; Ø250 pilot into the cartridge bore.

steps.title: Adapter screws
steps.text: 12 × M16 10.9 put in through the two side windows and the open rear, tightened to 248 Nm.

steps.title: Spindle-side coupling hub
steps.text: ROTEX 160 steel hub (Ø290) lowered through the adapter's Ø300 rear bore onto the Ø130 shaft end. Its B-LOC B400 130 × 180 is tightened from above through the Ø190 spider bore, in rounds to 123 Nm.

steps.title: Coupling spider
steps.text: 64 ShD polyurethane spider dropped into the jaws.

steps.title: Hydraulic motor
steps.text: On the bench: pilot plate onto the motor spigot, ROTEX 160 motor hub onto the W90 spline. The motor (Poclain MS18, ≈ 152 kg) is lowered onto the adapter: the hub passes the Ø300 bore and its jaws engage the spider; the plate's Ø300 spigot enters the bore.

steps.title: Motor screws
steps.text: 8 × M20 × 65 10.9 through the motor flange and pilot plate into the adapter, tightened to 484 Nm.

steps.title: Window guards
steps.text: 3 mm curved guard plates over both adapter windows, 4 × M6 each (rules 3.a.1: rotating parts guarded).

steps.title: Seal-purge supply, part 2
steps.text: Line continued from x = 1,095: down to R185 by x = 1,150, then back through the thrust-ring bore to the surface.

steps.title: Hoses
steps.text: Hoses A and B (3/4 in) and the case drain run back through the casing string to the HPU.

steps.title: Back to horizontal
steps.text: Machine laid horizontal on the launch cradle.

steps.title: Thrust ring onto the shield rear
steps.text: Thrust ring Rev B (A572-50, 76.2 thk, Ø609.6 × Ø400, U-notches 84 wide to R287 at 12 and 6, Ø589.5 × 10 register spigot) with 4 saddles welded to its rear face at R260, 2, 4, 8 and 10 o'clock. Slid on from the rear over the hoses, the notches over the slurry pipes, until the spigot is in the shield's Ø590.6 × 12 rear counterbore (radial gap 0.55) and the bearing face sits on the shield end wall (x = 1,157). No jacking pipes yet; not bolted.

steps.title: Jacking cylinders
steps.text: 4 × Chief WT 5 × 24 (bore 127, rod 63.5, stroke 609.6), retracted 889 pin to pin. Each rod-end cross tube (Ø63.5 × 101.6) goes between the ears into its Ø65 seat. Thrust path: rod → cross tube → seat → block → ring → shield. Barrel and gland lengths are approximate.

steps.title: Saddle pins
steps.text: Ø38.1 × 160 4140 pins through the ears and cross tubes, 2 clips each. The ear holes are slotted 3 toward the ring, so the pins carry load only in retract (50 bar, 47.5 kN per cylinder).
